taskPrompt: For an Account update, list every automation that runs, the order it runs in, and every record each one writes or references.
startingPoint: Account object in Setup with source metadata only, before any deployment or execution.

expansionProfile.notes: One after-save flow writing two objects; one inactive flow; two validation rules; one dynamic SOQL.

inclusionRationale: Highest-complexity robustness scenario: an after-save flow with two record-create targets, two validation rules, an inactive flow to exclude, and a dynamic Opportunity SOQL to leave unresolved, to stress multi-write parsing, exclusion and uncertainty together.
notes: Account update robustness case: trigger before/after with dependency class and dynamic Opportunity SOQL; before-save flow; after-save flow creating Case and Task; one Draft (inactive) flow; two validation rules.
